profile.headline: Software Engineer at Exelon
profile.summary: I have graduated from the University of Illinois at Chicago with a Bachelors in Computer Science in 2021. I am currently working as a Software Engineer at Exelon. I am a dedicated worker, critical thinker, and a driven individual. Interested in Full Stack Development, Mobile Apps, Azure, Middleware, and E2E IT architecture.

positions.title: Solutions Analyst
positions.description:
-Create architectural, flow, and sequence diagrams to design the end-to-end functionality of IT projects
-Create robust solutions with HA/DR capabilities to meet business vision and the IT Roadmap
-Work within an agile team environment to conduct the architecture governance program for IT projects
-Assist the IT Architecture and Engineering community in planning the introduction of new technologies and/or identifying the most appropriate technology choices to accomplish goals by utilizing standard governance process
-Serve as a secondary point of contact for the business and technical teams and provide influential guidance and consultation throughout the life of a project
-Assist in the development of white papers, conducting presentations as needed to explain why a technology is being recommended by IT

positions.title: Web Development Intern - Team Lead
positions.description:
-Developed and maintained Ecovici's website that refers users to vendor products using HTML and CSS. 
-Updated previous HTML/CSS code to make website more fluid and user friendly.
-Utilized Cloudflare CDN to improve page loading time by ~50%.

positions.title: Student Manager
positions.description: -Led a team of other students and developed on-the-spot problem solving skills, adaptability, accountability, and customer service.

positions.title: Team Member
positions.description: -Communicated with customers of all ages and backgrounds in order to set-up car service appointments that potentially led to more sales.

positions.title: Computer Sales Associate
positions.description:
-Sold and informed customers about various computer hardware and software. 
-Completed online modules for more knowledge on computer hardware.
-Gained knowledge Mac OS, Windows, and Linux.

projects.title: NoPanik
projects.description:
NoPanik is a multi-sensor system designed to be an all-in-one safeguard against threatening and unsafe situations.
-Controlled by Arduino Uno board
-Utilized Arduino ultrasonic sensors, switches, and Bluetooth module
-Created a mobile app to connect to the Arduino board via Bluetooth that sends out a distress phone call

projects.title: Personal Portfolio Website
projects.description: Developed a personal website to expand my knowledge in HTML and CSS. This website is designed to be my personal portfolio and as a learning platform to expand my knowledge of HTML, CSS, and Java Script. Used React framework as the base of the website and then was later published using GitHub pages.
